{
    "title": "Trading Community Finder",
    "type": "object",
    "schemaVersion": 1,
    "properties": {
        "keywords": { "title": "Search keywords", "type": "array", "editor": "stringList", "description": "What traders search on YouTube. The actor finds the channels for each keyword and the Telegram, Discord and WhatsApp communities they link to.", "prefill": ["forex signals", "señales forex"] },
        "telegramChannels": { "title": "Telegram channels you already know (optional)", "type": "array", "editor": "stringList", "description": "Usernames or t.me links. They are checked and used to discover related channels." },
        "nicheTerms": { "title": "Topic words", "type": "array", "editor": "stringList", "description": "A community must mention at least one of these in its name or description. Leave empty for the built-in trading list (forex, xauusd, señales, prop firm, mt5...)." },
        "maxChannelsPerKeyword": { "title": "YouTube channels per keyword", "type": "integer", "default": 10, "minimum": 1, "maximum": 50 },
        "videosToScanPerKeyword": { "title": "Recent videos to scan per keyword", "type": "integer", "default": 5, "minimum": 0, "maximum": 30, "description": "The most viewed videos of the last month; their descriptions usually link to the creator's Telegram or Discord." },
        "telegramDepth": { "title": "Telegram discovery depth", "type": "integer", "default": 1, "minimum": 0, "maximum": 2, "description": "1 = also check the channels that the found channels forward from or link to." },
        "maxTelegramChannels": { "title": "Max Telegram channels to check", "type": "integer", "default": 80, "minimum": 1, "maximum": 1000 },
        "minMembers": { "title": "Minimum members / subscribers", "type": "integer", "default": 500, "minimum": 0 },
        "maxDaysSinceLastPost": { "title": "Max days since last post (Telegram)", "type": "integer", "default": 60, "minimum": 0, "description": "0 = keep inactive channels too." },
        "languages": { "title": "Languages", "type": "array", "editor": "select", "items": { "type": "string", "enum": ["es", "en", "pt"], "enumTitles": ["Spanish", "English", "Portuguese"] }, "description": "Keep only these languages. Empty = all. Communities whose language can't be detected are kept." },
        "country": { "title": "YouTube country", "type": "string", "editor": "textfield", "default": "US", "description": "Two-letter code, e.g. US, CO, MX, ES." },
        "includeYouTubeChannels": { "title": "Include YouTube channels in results", "type": "boolean", "default": true },
        "includeUnknownSize": { "title": "Include communities with unknown size", "type": "boolean", "default": true, "description": "Private Telegram invites and WhatsApp groups don't show member counts." },
        "includeUnrelated": { "title": "Include off-topic communities", "type": "boolean", "default": false },
        "maxResults": { "title": "Max results", "type": "integer", "default": 200, "minimum": 1, "maximum": 5000 },
        "maxConcurrency": { "title": "Parallel requests", "type": "integer", "default": 4, "minimum": 1, "maximum": 8 }
    }
}
